data.title: Trillionaire Residences
data.about:
Trillionaire Residences by Binghatti, a modern masterpiece in Business Bay on the Dubai Water Canal, offers grandeur. This latest initiative by Binghatti has magnificent studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, and the ultimate of elegance and class, dedicated to the modern connoisseur.

Binghatti Trillionaire Residences for sale in Business Bay provide unmatched service and a luxurious cocoon evocative of a high-end resort in Dubai's bustling hub. Each property is a masterwork with a modern and luxurious design and a crystalline glass façade that lets in natural light and creates a sense of endless space and calm.

Trillionaire by Binghatti in Business Bay offers a wild lifestyle with stunning views of the Dubai Canal and the city's architectural marvels, including the Burj Khalifa. This property in the waterfront neighbourhood offers a refuge of modernism and incomparable elegance, guaranteeing you a bustling and prestigious lifestyle with spectacular views that are a visual symphony every day.

characteristics_module.title: Exquisite living and lavish elegance
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Starting from AED 1.5M
  • Prime location in Business Bay
  • Range of elegant studios to two-bedroom apartments
  • Resort-like amenities and services
  • Futuristic and opulent design with crystalline glass facades
  • Unbeatable views of Dubai Canal and Burj Khalifa
  • Waterfront living at its finest
  • Commitment to sustainable and green living features

location_tile.title: A Convienient Location
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the heart of Business Bay on the bustling Sheikh Zayed Road, Trillionaire Residences by Binghatti promises not only luxurious living but also a convenient and connected lifestyle. Residents enjoy swift access to major hubs of the city, including the iconic Burj Khalifa and the picturesque Dubai Water Canal. Its prime location ensures that the vibrant life of Dubai is always within reach, facilitating a life of ease, with the best of the city's entertainment, dining, and leisure venues just a stone's throw away.

  • 05 Minutes from Downtown Dubai
  • 15 Minutes from DXB International Airport
  • 25 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 40 Minutes to DWC International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Trillionaire Residences by Binghatti features modern studios and 1-2 bedroom apartments in Business Bay, offering luxury living by the Dubai Water Canal.
